title: QSMP 2 Semi-Recreation
description: This project was created for players who want to experience the unique vibe of the original server while enjoying smooth and stable performance.
body:
🌟 QSMP 2 Fanmade Edition (120+ Mods)

Welcome! This is a fan-made, unofficial modpack inspired by the second season of the popular QSMP server.

This project was created for players who want to experience the unique vibe of the original server while enjoying smooth and stable performance.

⚙️ Features:
Around 120 selected mods – A great mix of the essential adventure, tech, and decoration mods from the series.

Better optimization – Includes the core gameplay elements of QSMP 2 without the heavy mods that cause lag on average PCs.

Original atmosphere – The perfect modpack to play with friends and recreate your own Egg Island adventures!

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This is a 100% fan-made and free project (Non-profit).

This modpack is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Quackity or the official QSMP team.

All rights to the individual mods belong to their respective creators. This pack does not distribute original .jar files directly, only a manifest linking to their official versions.
